description: Explicit duplicate merges applied by scripts/sync.py after de-duplication. Each rule names one copy of the card to keep and one to absorb (normalized title + first year of any member). The absorbed card's records join the kept card; its ID is retired and no other ID shifts. Optional title/subtitle override the merged card's display title, and conflict_note is appended to its source-conflict line.

rules.conflict_note: Merged with the duplicate 1965 card. Wikipedia says it was filmed in 1965, back-to-back with Dracula: Prince of Darkness at Bray Studios, and released in the UK in 1966
